server.name: OpsDesk
server.state: fictional PostgreSQL demo_* tables only for tool behavior

annotation_rule: MCP annotations are advisory metadata only. No risk/authorization decision may derive from readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint, title or description.
model_schema_rule: The model-visible tool schema must omit runtime-owned idempotency_key. The wire MCP schema must require it. B50 will mint it in trusted runtime code before an approved call.
raw_side_effect_rule: B40 proves raw fictional-state mutation only. Raw side-effect calls are infrastructure/test surface and are not authorization-complete. They must not be connected to the graph before B50.
raw_duplicate_rule: For note/notification rows, derive deterministic row identity from tool name + idempotency_key so a direct duplicate raw dispatch fails closed instead of creating a second row. Do not claim B50 replay/receipt semantics in B40.
restart_rule: A successful raw restart of a known fictional service changes demo_services.status to 'healthy' and returns previous_status plus final status. B50 later supplies approval/effect-receipt semantics.
filesystem_rule: No tool accepts filesystem paths or URLs and the server performs no arbitrary host filesystem/network access.
